questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Keep formal register

stimulus.body: Log line: 'The seeing was atrocious; we packed up at midnight.' Target: formal Spanish report.

questions.stem: Which rendering best preserves formal register?

options.text: El seeing fue atroz; recogimos a medianoche.
La visibilidad fue terrible; nos fuimos a medianoche.
Las condiciones de observación fueron deficientes; suspendimos la sesión a medianoche.
Había muy mala visibilidad; nos marchamos a media noche.

questions.explanation: Option C keeps formality and technical precision. The others keep English, lose precision, or sound colloquial.

questions.learningObjective: Summarise faithfully
questions.stem: Summarise: 'After three hours of aligning, the GoTo slewed to the wrong star, so I star-hopped manually.'

answer.exemplar: A failed GoTo slew forced the astronomer to star-hop manually after a long alignment.

questions.explanation: The summary keeps the failed slew and the manual fallback. It drops the three-hour duration as secondary.
